name: Template: Legal & Compliance
description: Track contracts, policy requests, and compliance reviews. Each swimlane is a practice area; each card is a request or obligation.

swimlanes.name: Contracts & Procurement
swimlanes.notes: Vendor MSAs, order forms, procurement agreements. Average turnaround: 5 business days.

swimlanes.name: Employment Law
swimlanes.notes: Employment agreements, terminations, equity plans, HR policy reviews. Sensitive — restricted access.

swimlanes.name: Intellectual Property
swimlanes.notes: Trademarks, patents, open-source license compliance, IP assignments. Annual IP audit required.

swimlanes.name: Data Privacy (GDPR)
swimlanes.notes: DPAs, GDPR compliance, data subject requests, privacy impact assessments. DPO oversight.

swimlanes.name: Regulatory Compliance
swimlanes.notes: SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, industry-specific regulations. Audit deadlines are hard stops.

swimlanes.name: Corporate Governance
swimlanes.notes: Board resolutions, shareholder agreements, corporate filings. Quarterly board meeting prep.

swimlanes.name: Litigation Management
swimlanes.notes: Active disputes, demand letters, settlement negotiations. Outside counsel: Morrison & Associates.

swimlanes.name: Insurance & Risk
swimlanes.notes: D&O, E&O, cyber liability, general liability. Annual renewal cycle: November.

swimlanes.name: Real Estate & Leases
swimlanes.notes: Office leases, co-working agreements, lease renewals. SF office lease expires Dec 2027.

swimlanes.name: Tax & Finance
swimlanes.notes: Tax filings, transfer pricing, R&D tax credits, sales tax nexus. External advisor: Deloitte.
